title: EvalsRunSuiteInput
description: Read from the merged `{ ...ctx.config, ...ctx.inputs }` bag (inputs win). The surface refuses a missing suite or agent with a typed failure.

suiteRef.description: The suite ref, <suiteId>@<version> (a tenant suite or a pack-shipped one).

baselineRunId.description: Optional earlier eval run of the same suite; adds the regression verdict.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the eval run. Default and maximum 540000 (inside the 600000 ms run-duration ceiling). On timeout the eval run is cancelled and the node fails.

pollIntervalMs.description: How often to read the run's status. Default 2000.
